en-US.description:
Seven spins, sixty years of pro football, one shot at an undefeated season.

Each spin hands you one franchise and one era. Take a player, fill a slot, and live with it. Seven picks decide your season — no simulation, no luck after the whistle.

Three ways to play. Rookie shows you every rating. Scout gives you the stat line and no grade. GM Mode gives you a name and a year, and nothing else.

Every rating is computed from what actually happened, against the era it happened in. 18-0 lands about once every 6,000 games.
en-US.promotionalText: Each spin hands you one franchise and one era. Seven picks decide a season, rated against the era it was played in. 18-0 lands about once every 6,000 games.

_ageRatingComment: The questionnaire, from docs/submission.md. Enum fields take NONE / INFREQUENT_OR_MILD / FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE / INFREQUENT / FREQUENT; the rest are booleans. userGeneratedContent is the only yes, and it is the display name -- filtered when chosen and reportable by anyone. kidsAgeBand is deliberately absent: this is not a Kids Category app, and setting it opts into rules that are much stricter than the game needs.
